headline: Berhyanda Limited files Regulation 31(4) disclosure for substantial acquisition in Cohance Lifesciences
sum: Berhyanda Limited has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4) for a substantial acquisition of shares in Cohance Lifesciences Limited. The filing was submitted to NSE on 23 June 2026.
implication: A Reg 31(4) disclosure signals that an acquirer has crossed the statutory 25% threshold triggering open offer obligations; counsel must immediately review the disclosure for trigger-crossing details, exemption claims, and the timeline and mechanics for the mandatory offer.
detail: Berhyanda Limited has made a regulatory disclosure to NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4). This regulation mandates disclosure when a person acquires shares that result in aggregate shareholding crossing defined thresholds (typically 25%, 50%, or 75%). The filing confirms the acquirer's intention to comply with open offer requirements if applicable.

framework.note: Mandatory disclosure of substantial acquisition crossing 25% threshold; triggers open offer obligation unless exempted
Definition of 'acquirer' and persons acting in concert; material for understanding control and disclosure trigger
Open offer mechanics, exemptions (e.g. gifts, inheritances, stock splits), and conditions for waiver or exemption
Disclosure norms post-acquisition and ongoing reporting during the open offer period
Director appointment and disclosure obligations following change of control or substantial shareholding
Material event disclosure to stock exchange; continuity of listing and corporate governance post-acquisition
Foreign Direct Investment reporting if Berhyanda is a non-resident; approval and disclosure under FDI policy

framework.ref: Prevention of Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices (CCI), 2023
framework.note: If combined enterprise crosses size threshold, CCI approval may be required; check acquirer+target turnover

conditions: Mandatory open offer to remaining shareholders unless exempted
approvals: Potential CCI approval if combined enterprise size triggers acquisition threshold
Board and shareholder approval for the offer (if material related party transaction)

triggers.note: Acquisition of 25%+ shares mandates public disclosure and triggers open offer obligation
Material acquisition event requiring immediate disclosure to stock exchange
Change in directorship/control may trigger director disclosure and appointment rules
